data.notes: Search budget (20) used. Most values from ADAC Autokatalog/Gebrauchtwageninfo and spec databases because manufacturer press kits for older generations were not found; only Octavia Combi III base data come from skoda-media.de. Fabia 5J wheelbase differs between ADAC entries (2462 pre-facelift, 2451 facelift). Fabia Combi 5J Facelift trunk 505/1485 l (ADAC) vs 480/1460 l pre-facelift - not verified by Škoda.

corrections.evidence: cars-data.com (Fabia 1.4 16V 2001-2004 and 2004 L&K): length 3960, width 1646, height 1451 mm, wheelbase 2462, boot 260 l; fastcarcheck.uk lists the same height; auto-data.net gives 1450 mm. Only autoplenum gives 1436 mm.
encyCARpedia Fabia vRS (2003): cargo space 260-1,016 l (database, same as other 6Y hatch variants).
auto-data.net Fabia II Combi (facelift 2010) RS 1.4 TSI 180 PS: trunk 505-1485 l (database). Consistent with de.wikipedia Fabia II: Combi 'seit 2010 auf 505/1485 l'.
auto motor und sport technische Daten Fabia RS: Außenmaße 4029 x 1642 x 1492 mm; auto-data.net also 4029 mm.
auto motor und sport: 4029 x 1642 x 1492 mm.
encyCARpedia Octavia Scout 2.0 TDI 4x4 (2007-2009): length 4,581 mm, cargo 580-1,620 l (database).
auto-data.net Octavia II Combi (facelift 2009) 1.4 TSI 122 PS: length 4569 mm, height 1462 mm (database).
encyCARpedia Octavia Combi 2.0 TDI 4x4 / 1.6 TDI 4x4 / 1.8 TSI 4x4 (2013): 610-1.740 l, length 4,659 mm; automobilrevue.cz 4x4 test also 610/1740 l.

Test of Octavia Combi 1.4 TSI G-TEC: boot drops to 480 / 1,610 l (normally 610 / 1,740 l). encyCARpedia 1.4 TSI G-TEC Combi (2017-2019) also 480-1,610 l. Medium confidence: search summary cited several reviews with partly differing values.
Test of Octavia Combi 1.4 TSI G-TEC: 480 / 1,610 l.

missing.detail: 5E Combi Facelift (2017-2020): 1.4 TSI G-TEC 110 PS (2017-2018/19) missing; encyCARpedia 'Octavia Combi 1.4 TSI G-TEC 110 (2017-2019)' gives 480-1,610 l (https://www.encycarpedia.com/skoda/17-octavia-combi-1-4-tsi-g-tec-lpg-110-estate). The existing 1.5 G-TEC row has yearFrom 2019 only.

5E Combi Facelift: RS 245 (2017+) Combi height 1,452 mm, width 1,814 mm per Škoda press kit (https://www.skoda-storyboard.com/en/press-kits/skoda-octavia-rs-245-sporty-spacious-practical-family-sportster-delivers-245-ps/attachment/occ_rs_245_00008/); RS variant row currently all null. Škoda 2017 Scout press kit confirms Scout length 4,687 mm.
6Y RS 1.9 TDI: dimensions differ from base (auto.ru: length 4002 mm, height 1440 mm) - only one non-manufacturer source, not entered as correction.

verification.notes: 18 searches used. Confirmed: Fabia 6Y length 3960 (3970 in some DBs), width 1646, wheelbase 2462, 260/1016 l; Fabia Combi 6Y 4222/1646/1452/2462, 426/1225 l; Fabia 5J 3992/1642/1498, 300/1163 l; Fabia Combi 5J 4239, 480/1460 l and facelift 505/1485 l (de.wikipedia Fabia II explicitly: 'seit 2010 auf 505/1485 l'); Fabia NJ 3992/1732/1467/2470, 330/1150 l; Fabia Combi NJ 530/1395 l; Octavia Combi 1Z 4572/1769/1462/2578, 580/1620 l (Škoda storyboard: '580 litres (1,620 with the rear seats folded down)'); Octavia Combi 5E 4659/1814/1465/2686, 610/1740 l; 5E Facelift length 4667 (Škoda 2017 press kit: estate grew 8 mm to 4,667 mm), Scout 4687 mm. Open conflicts not corrected: de.wikipedia Fabia II infobox gives wheelbase 2462 mm (vs. 2451 used for facelift from ADAC) - no clear manufacturer figure found. Octavia Combi 1Z Facelift: auto-data.net gives 605/1655 l for 1.4 TSI facelift vs. 580/1620 l (ADAC RS) - possibly changed measurement method; not corrected without manufacturer source. Fabia Combi 5J Facelift yearFrom 2011 vs. hatch facelift 2010 - facelift was 2010 for both bodies; consider aligning. Fabia NJ Combi length 4257 not directly confirmed by manufacturer (mobile.de ~4.26 m).
